question: What is the meaning of reuse of parts in relation to disassembly?
description: Reusing parts in relation to disassembly refers to the ability to remove components or materials from a product or building without causing damage, allowing them to be utilized again for their original purpose or in a different location. This practice aims to maximize the lifespan and value of the materials, promoting sustainability and resource efficiency.
